title: Workspace AI assistant
description: Review this month's content plan, understand its coverage, and explore practical improvements.
emptyTitle: What would you like to understand about this plan?
emptyDescription: Ask about plan coverage, the posting schedule, or content mix. The assistant uses a bounded summary of this workspace and explains what it can support with evidence.
placeholder: Ask a question about this month's plan…
boundedData: This review used a maximum of 200 active plan items.
completeData: All active plan items in this period were included.
error: The assistant could not complete this request. Check AI availability and try again.
errorTruncated: The assistant's answer was cut off because it reached the model's output limit. Try asking about a narrower part of the plan.
errorEmpty: The model used its whole response budget without producing an answer. Try again, or choose a different reasoning level.
errorInvalid: The assistant received an answer it could not use. Please try again.
errorProvider: The AI provider is not available right now. Please try again in a moment.
errorRateLimited: The AI provider's usage allowance for this period is used up. Please try again later.
privacy: Conversations are private to you in this workspace. You can rename, archive, or delete them.
readOnly: The assistant can prepare edit previews for a selected draft. Nothing changes until you apply a preview.
modeAskDescription: Ask reads authorized workspace information and cannot prepare changes.
modePlanDescription: Plan prepares a preview for an explicitly selected draft. It never changes Planner data.
modeApplyDescription: Apply lets you confirm a prepared change one at a time. Each Apply button is a separate confirmation.
renamePrompt: Enter a name for this conversation
promptParametersHelp: Use {{parameter_key}} in the goal or instructions. Inputs only fill the template; they do not grant access.
promptError: The prompt could not be saved. Check your sharing permissions and try again.
promptsLoadError: Prompts could not be loaded. Check access and try again.
confirmDelete: Delete this conversation and all of its messages? This cannot be undone.
contentReferenceHint: Paste a Planner link, item ID or title, or a plan month
contentReferenceNotFound: No accessible content item matched that reference. Check its title, link, or ID.
chooseContentReference: Several items match. Choose the one to include
runResultUnavailable: This run finished while you were away. Its response was not saved; send your request again to view it.
editStale: This preview is stale because the content changed. Create a new one.
editExpired: This preview expired. Create a new one.
editStatusError: The decision could not be saved. Try again.
noConversations: No conversations yet. Start a new conversation to begin.
conversationRestored: For privacy, message text is not restored when you reopen a conversation. Its approved previews remain available.

knowledge.title: Workspace knowledge
knowledge.description: Keep brand, audience, strategy, and reference notes available to the assistant. Shared notes never share workspace access.
knowledge.defaultNotice: Planner starter guidance offers general planning recommendations. Add workspace notes for your brand, audience, products, offers, results, and operating details. Copy a default note to tailor it for this workspace.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.empty: No knowledge found. Add guidance that should inform assistant responses.
knowledge.error: Knowledge could not be saved or loaded. Check access and try again.
knowledge.confirmArchive: Archive this knowledge entry? It will no longer be used by the assistant.
